_comment: Copy this to roboframe.secrets.json beside roboframe.config.json and fill in your values (chmod 600). The file is gitignored. It has the config's own shape and is merged over it, so tokens stay out of the file you open and paste while tuning settings; env vars still override both. `node scripts/split-secrets.js` moves these keys out of an existing config. Point at another file with ROBOFRAME_SECRETS.
_accessTokenComment: Read-mostly token shared by every WebSocket consumer (kiosks, node-display, hypnos). Required to connect to /rpc/ws but cannot call privileged `rpcsend`. Top-level so the same value can be copied to client and server configs.

server._rpcTokenComment: Privileged tier: required for rpcsend over WebSocket and HTTP /rpc/send. Must differ from accessToken. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 16`. Env override: RPC_TOKEN.

webcam._comment_tokens: Optional. When non-empty, every media endpoint (/stream.mjpg, /snapshot.jpg, /audio.pcm) requires one of these tokens via `?token=<t>` or `Authorization: Bearer <t>`. /health stays open. Use a long random value, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 24`. Gates both the LAN port and any tailscale-serve path.
